sql_templates.template:
WITH recent_events AS (
    SELECT 
        ce.symbol,
        ce.event_type,

        ce.detail,
        ce.source,
        sa.company_name,
        sa.period_label,

LIMIT 10;

sql_templates.description: Retrieve latest sector data with Stage 2 participation.
sql_templates.sql:
SELECT 
                sd.sector, 
                sd.breadth_signal, 
                ssp.stage2_pct, 
                AVG(ss.stage_score) AS avg_stage_score 
            FROM 
                breadth.sector_daily sd 
            JOIN 
                scores.stage_snapshots ss 
            ON 
                sd.sector = ss.sector 
            JOIN 
                breadth.ma_pct_above ssp 
            ON 
                sd.snapshot_date = ssp.snapshot_date 
            WHERE 
                sd.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) 
            GROUP BY 
                sd.sector, 
                sd.breadth_signal, 
                ssp.stage2_pct 
            ORDER BY 
                avg_stage_score DESC, 
                ssp.stage2_pct DESC 
            LIMIT 10;
